item-handbooktext-static-saber:
A great choice for efficiently slicing through enemies. The blade can be heated until red-hot to set enemies on fire.
When discharged, it will stop dealing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-spear:
A great choice for putting holes in enemies. Has two throwing modes: normal and ionizing spear. In the second mode, upon hitting any living creature, the spear causes strong air ionization. This triggers a lightning strike and sets the creature on fire. Consumes 10% of charge capacity.
Playing with lightning is dangerous - be careful.
When discharged, it will stop dealing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-shield:
Excellent protection with a built-in lantern.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-helmet:
Excellent protection and capabilities.
When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-armor: Excellent protection and capabilities. When discharged, it will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-boots:
Excellent protection and capabilities.
When discharged, they will stop absorbing damage. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-static-glider:
Excellent capabilities.
When you have charge during flight, press shift — and you will quickly gain speed. This allows you to travel long distances. With practice, you can even take off from the ground, but it will consume more charge.
item-handbooktext-edrill:
Mineral extraction reaches a new level. Allows operation in several modes: 1x1, 1x3 (vertical), 3x1 (horizontal), 3x3. In 3x3 mode, consumption is increased by 3 times.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-echisel:
Performs the functions of a chisel on batteries! A hammer in the left hand is not needed. Not usable in recipes.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to recharge!
item-handbooktext-edrilltip: The base for the electric drill.
item-handbooktext-eaxe:
Excels at chopping wood. Not usable in recipes.
When discharged, it will stop working. Don't forget to recharge!
